title: RCAN gate_decision evidence record (informative, v0.1)
description: One record per safety-gate decision (allow, clamp, reject, stop). Appendix C requirement R5. Records form an append-only chain: prev is the hash of the previous record, hash is sha256 over the canonical JSON (spec/audit-bundle-v1.md rules) of this record with the hash member removed. The first record's prev is sha256: followed by 64 zeros. Optional: an implementation that emits these records MAY also keep emitting the §6 audit record for the same command.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number, contiguous within one chain.

t.description: Unix epoch milliseconds at which the gate decided.

principal.description: Who the command is attributed to (§2 principal). For a decision the gate originates itself, such as a watchdog stop, the gate's own identity (e.g. gate:watchdog).

authority.description: Reference to the grant that authorised the command (e.g. JWT jti, AUTHORIZE message_id). Resolved externally; this profile does not define identity or delegation. Null only when no authority was presented, in which case the decision for an authority-gated action MUST NOT be allow or clamp.

cmd.description: The command as proposed to the gate, or null for a decision the gate originated itself.

applied.description: What was actually sent to the actuators. Equal to cmd for allow; the modified command for clamp; null for reject; the stop action for stop.

reason.description: Why the gate clamped, rejected or stopped. Required for those three decisions.

envelope.description: Hash of the envelope in force (canonical JSON with signature removed).

state_digest.description: Digest of the state snapshot the decision was made on.
